market_definition: Firestop Sealants comprises sealant products installed in joints and penetrations to maintain fire-resistance performance in walls, floors and building assemblies. The market covers firestop sealant materials and excludes complete fire-protection systems. By Chemistry • Silicone-Based • Acrylic-Based • Polyurethane-Based • Intumescent Formulations By Installation Area • Through-Penetration • Construction Joints • Perimeter Joints By Performance Rating • 1-Hour • 2-Hour • 3-Hour • 4-Hour By Form • Cartridge • Sausage • Pail By End Use • Commercial Buildings • Residential Buildings • Healthcare and Education • Industrial Facilities By Region • North America • Europe • Asia Pacific • Latin America • Middle East • Africa EXCLUDED from the market: Firestop collars, wraps, boards, mortars, dampers, detection systems and general-purpose sealants without firestop positioning. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
